lcc_original: 水把地上的衆生、從人類到獸類、到爬行動物、以及空中的飛鳥、都擦滅了；他們都從地上被擦滅。只有挪亞和那些同他在樓船裏的、得存活，
notes: LCC adds 水 (water) as the explicit subject for the active Qal verb וַיִּמַח; no Hebrew SN exists for 水 in this verse so it is left unannotated.

LCC splits the verse's 'wiping out' concept into two clauses: active '都擦滅了' (unannotated—corresponds to the Qal form, which has no separate SN in UNV) and passive '被擦滅' (annotated WH04229+WTH8735, corresponding to the Niphal וַיִּמָּחוּ whose morphology H8735 = Niphal matches the passive voice).

{<WAH0853>} implicit braces dropped because LCC has explicit 把 as object marker (= Hebrew אֵת); similarly {<WAH05704>} braces dropped for explicit 到 in the creeping-things clause and 以及 in the birds clause.
衆生 absorbs both WAH03605 (כֹּל = all) and WH03351 (יְקוּם = living things) since LCC collapses UNV's 各類的活物 into one word.
LCC's 得存活 at the end corresponds to UNV's 留下 (WH07604 שָׁאַר + WTH8735 Niphal = remained/survived); the survival is implied in UNV's sentence structure but made explicit in LCC.
